ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.
   B. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Names of Scriptures able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Names of Scriptures able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Names of Scriptures able to: has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Names of Scriptures able to:.
   D. Use Names of Scriptures able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of My extended family? (1 mark)
   A. Say My extended family has no place in daily life.
   B. Use My extended family to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of My extended family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My extended family.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Enlightened Beings able to:? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Enlightened Beings able to: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Enlightened Beings able to: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say The Enlightened Beings able to: has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Enlightened Beings able to:.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Belief in to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. Which response best shows understanding of Surah Naas? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Surah Naas with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Surah Naas to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Surah Naas has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah Naas.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

10. Which response best shows understanding of Manners of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Manners of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Manners of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Manners of.
   D. Say Manners of has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   C. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   C. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

14. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Manners of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Names of Scriptures able to: and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Eid and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Simple postures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
